report.clinical_summary: A patient with a chronic illness (diagnosed 3 years ago, symptoms likely started earlier) experiencing significant fatigue and headaches that make simple tasks 'insurmountable' on some days. They struggle to maintain work and family responsibilities. They have inconsistent adherence to Triumeq due to practical difficulties and specific concerns about long-term harm and side effects. They understand how the medication works but worry about unforeseen consequences. They have mixed views on the future—some hope for breakthroughs but also feel it will always be a struggle. They recognize some control over medication adherence but feel out of control regarding illness progression and emotional impact.
